shortDescription: Create and manage cloud servers on the Hetzner Cloud.

options.name: api_endpoint
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_endpoint_hetzner
options.description: The endpoint for the Hetzner API. You can also set this option by using the C(HETZNER_ENDPOINT) environment variable.

options.name: api_token
options.description: The token for the Hetzner Cloud API. You can also set this option by using the C(HCLOUD_TOKEN) environment variable.

options.name: backups
options.description: Enable or disable Backups for the given Server.

options.name: delete_protection
options.description: Protect the Server for deletion. Needs to be the same as O(rebuild_protection).

options.name: enable_ipv4
options.description: Enables the public ipv4 address.

options.name: enable_ipv6
options.description: Enables the public ipv6 address.

options.name: firewalls
options.description: List of Hetzner Cloud Firewalls (name or ID) that should be attached to the server.

options.name: force
options.description: Force the update of the server. May power off the server if update is applied.

options.name: id
options.description: ID of the Hetzner Cloud Server to manage. Only required if no server O(name) is given

options.name: image
options.description: Hetzner Cloud Image (name or ID) to create the server from. Required if server does not exist or when O(state=rebuild).

options.name: image_allow_deprecated
options.description: Allows the creation of servers with deprecated images.

options.name: ipv4
options.description: Hetzner Cloud Primary IPv4 (name or ID) to use. If omitted and O(enable_ipv4=true), a new ipv4 Primary IP will automatically be created.

options.name: ipv6
options.description: Hetzner Cloud Primary IPv6 (name or ID) to use. If omitted and O(enable_ipv6=true), a new ipv6 Primary IP will automatically be created.

options.name: labels
options.description: User-defined labels (key-value pairs).

options.name: location
options.description: Hetzner Cloud Location (name or ID) to create the server in. Required if the server does not exist. Only used during the server creation.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the Hetzner Cloud Server to manage. Only required if no server O(id) is given or a server does not exist.

options.name: placement_group
options.description: Hetzner Cloud Placement Group (name or ID) to create the server in.

options.name: private_networks
options.description: List of Hetzner Cloud Networks (name or ID) the server should be attached to. If None, private networks are left as they are (e.g. if previously added by hcloud_server_network), if it has any other value (including []), only those networks are attached to the server.

options.name: rebuild_protection
options.description: Protect the Server for rebuild. Needs to be the same as O(delete_protection).

options.name: rescue_mode
options.description: Add the Hetzner rescue system type you want the server to be booted into.

options.name: server_type
options.description: Hetzner Cloud Server Type (name or ID) of the server. Required if server does not exist.

options.name: ssh_keys
options.description: List of Hetzner Cloud SSH Keys (name or ID) to create the server with. Only used during the server creation.

options.name: state
options.description: State of the server.

options.name: upgrade_disk
options.description: Resize the disk size, when resizing a server. If you want to downgrade the server later, this value should be False.

options.name: user_data
options.description: User Data to be passed to the server on creation. C(cloud-init), C(ignition) or similar provisioning tools may retrieve user configuration from the Server's C(user_data). Used during the server creation or server rebuild.

options.name: volumes
options.description: List of Hetzner Cloud Volumes (name or ID) that should be attached to the server. Only used during the server creation.
